candidate: Cyclic Freight Service Design with Cross-Dock Handling

full_model_failure.error: Shipment balance assigns supply +1 at O0 but demand -1 at both D2 and D3, requiring two sink units for one load.

mini_first_failure.error: The formulation imposes binary flow conservation for each named tractor on a modulo-week graph but does not preserve elapsed time or connected physical routes. It treats a 12-slot winding cycle as one weekly tractor rotation.

replication.error: Counts tractors from arcs whose tail is slot 3, omitting long service arcs that cross the weekly boundary.

scope_note: One gpt-5.4 low-reasoning run and two independent gpt-5-mini high-reasoning runs fail through two distinct formulation errors. The same final prompt was modeled correctly in high-reasoning runs of gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, gpt-5.5-2026-04-23, and gpt-5.6-luna.
